name: 44507 · Youngstown, OH
findings: ZIP 44507 (Youngstown) has 35 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 44507 (Youngstown) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 44507 (Youngstown) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 7 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
